The draft is now complete and proposes reopening the lab for up to 20 students with standard protective equipment, ordinary end-of-class cleanup, and Ms. Ortiz as the instructor. Before I make a decision on approval, I'd like to follow our normal pre-authorization routine and hear final input from the instructor, safety officer, nurse, and industry-partnership coordinator. I submitted the test results to maintenance, but it appears the revised operating-plan folder hasn't been updated with this information yet.
